The legal difference between LSVs and golf carts comes down to equipment and registration. LSVs must be titled, registered, insured, and built with mirrors, windshield, and wipers. Golf carts have none of that by default, which is why they're restricted unless a town passes an ordinance to allow them.

LSVs are marginally safer on paper, but significantly more expensive, double the cost or more, putting them out of reach for many residents.

I don't believe the windshield wipers or title titling meaningfully changes safety outcomes here. The safety gap I do see is liability insurance.

Pairing a golf cart approved ordinance with required insurance and possibly seat belts would close that safety gap while keeping golf carts affordable.

I don't think anyone's argued against golf carts so much as no one's made the case for them yet. So let me make it because that is why I'm here tonight. I don't think it's right that only the families with an extra ten grand to spare get to enjoy getting around Borrenton in this way.

Beyond affordability, this is about preserving our small town, helping our old town businesses thrive and keeping our community connected.

So picture this, taking your grandkids up to Main Street in a golf cart for an ice cream cone or picture puttering over to your friend's house for a cookout in the next neighborhood over, waving to your neighbors as you pass by.

Golf carts give residents an affordable way to easily connect with each other and to Old Town as Nova keeps expanding towards us, holding on to that family friendly classic small town charm matters more every year.

Additionally, golf cart usage would increase patronage to our Old Town businesses. Residents are more likely to go on a whim for dinner or coffee, for example, when the ride itself is part of the fun, not just a means to get there.

Regarding safety impact, Some of the benefits are that it would slow traffic slightly, particularly on Main Street here, which would increase pedestrian awareness and give drivers vastly superior visibility over drivers in traditional vehicles.

So in closing, I'd like to propose to the council to consider adopting an ordinance to allow golf carts. Thank you.
